title: needs-decision: resolve-review-thread has no claimless mode for operator-authorized unclaimed PRs
body:
# needs-decision: resolve-review-thread has no claimless mode for operator-authorized unclaimed PRs

## Background

Refs #2586. `resolve-review-thread.mjs --help` documents `--claim-issue
<number>`/`--claim-id <claim-id>` as both required with `--apply` — a
deliberate safety property for the normal autonomous-claim case
(re-validating the active claim before the reply-and-resolve mutation).

Not every PR in an adopter repository's actual workflow is created
through the Discover→Claim ceremony. A small, directly
operator-authorized maintenance/policy PR (observed:
`kurone-kito/setup.kito` PR #103, a one-line `.github/idd/config.json`
change explicitly requested and approved by the repository owner in an
interactive session, with no corresponding IDD issue or claim) has no
claim-issue/claim-id to supply. When an advisory bot posted a
false-positive review comment on that PR, `resolve-review-thread.mjs
--apply` could not be used at all, and the fallback was a hand-rolled
REST+GraphQL reply-and-resolve sequence that bypasses the helper's
stamped reply-identity convention (the `**Rejected** — {reason}`
prefix and the `<!-- {markerPrefix}-review-reply -->` stamp).

Two sibling claim-aware helpers already solve an analogous no-claim
case differently, giving precedent for either direction here.
`pre-merge-readiness.mjs` added `--claimless` for a no-issue PR
(#2017, decided 2026-08-17: gated the same way
`external-check-waiver.mjs`'s existing `--claimless` is — an explicit
flag, rejects combination with `--claim-issue`/`--claim-id`, scoped to
PRs with no `closingIssuesReferences`). `resolve-review-thread.mjs`
never received the same treatment.

## Proposed change

No single proposed change: this is a maintainer decision among the
options below, the same pattern #2017/#2091/#2181/#2377 used for this
class of problem.

### Options for a maintainer to choose among

1. **Add an explicit `--claimless` mode**, mirroring #2017's
   `pre-merge-readiness` precedent: reject combining it with
   `--claim-issue`/`--claim-id`, and still enforce the
   `**Rejected**`/`**Accepted**` reply-prefix and
   `<!-- {markerPrefix}-review-reply -->` stamp conventions without
   requiring a claim to re-validate against.
2. **Document the fallback explicitly instead of changing the helper.**
   State, at the point `resolve-review-thread.mjs --help` (or its
   missing-flag error message) reports the requirement, that a
   claim-less, directly-authorized PR is expected to use the manual
   REST+GraphQL fallback — not only in a separate instructions file, as
   today.
3. **Something else the maintainer prefers.**

## Acceptance criteria

- A maintainer states which option above to take (or a different
  resolution) in a comment on this issue.
- Close this issue once that decision is recorded. The chosen option
  becomes a follow-up `ready` issue scoped to the exact flag/docs
  change, mirroring how #2017/#2091/#2181/#2377 were resolved — this
  issue itself stays decision-only.

## Candidate files

- `src/scripts/resolve-review-thread.mts`
- `.github/instructions/idd-review-triage.instructions.md`

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable;
below the configured floor is human-oriented. This is a design-symmetry
trade-off with a settled precedent (#2017); the field evidence above is
already gathered and does not need re-deriving._
